{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player-input moves from the video, and write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.","required_artifacts":["/app/solution.txt","local copy of the referenced video or equivalent downloaded media evidence"],"required_behaviors":["Acquire the referenced video content from the provided URL.","Determine the complete ordered sequence of text commands/moves entered by the player.","Write exactly one move per line into /app/solution.txt using the move text as shown in the video."],"known_invalid_patterns":["Guessing or inventing moves without evidence from the video.","Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient evidence.","Using partial transcript or partial move list as completion."],"verification_plan":["Inspect available tools and workspace.","Download or otherwise access the referenced video.","Extract the move sequence from the video content with receipt-backed evidence.","Write /app/solution.txt and verify its contents against the extracted sequence."],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed evidence that the referenced video was acquired or accessed.","Receipt-backed evidence showing the extracted full move list.","Receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt contains the same full move list, one per line."],"notes":["If direct download is unavailable, use any visible alternate route that still yields the video content and transcriptable moves."]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"set -euo pipefail
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '\nFILES\n'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
printf '\nTOOLS\n'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget jq; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)"; done","receipt":"r1"}]}
